Chat settings
Codex runs the agent inside Atlas. API-key sessions use API billing; ChatGPT sessions use your available plan access.
Not signed in
Sign in in your browser. Codex manages the account session in the operating system credential store. Account access and plan limits apply.
Codex manages context compaction and research execution. Model access and supported reasoning efforts depend on your account. The model catalogue is not a guarantee of access.
Capabilities
Web search uses your provider and may incur additional charges. Replies include source links. Requires a model that supports web search.
Research can continue across as many model/tool rounds as Codex needs. Stop cancels the active turn. Workspace tools are confined to this conversation’s research directory; requests for extra access are shown for your approval.

 
About YC Atlas
YC Atlas is an independent explorer of the public Y Combinator company directory.
Topics are derived from YC tags and industry fields. Description keywords do not assign topics. They overlap and are not official YC cohorts. Company details and logos come from YC and may change.
Overview clusters show a selection of company logos. Open a topic to browse every matching company. Topic bubble area is proportional to the number of matching companies. Topics overlap, so a company may be counted in several bubbles. Topic positions are scattered for navigation. Within a topic, company positions use local sentence embeddings (MiniLM) and a UMAP projection of description similarity. Nearby points tend to have related descriptions; axes have no units and distances are approximate. K-means groups are labeled using distinctive description terms. Regions show the density of description groups, not company counts. Select a region to reveal its company logos while other regions remain collapsed. Map settings let you display 50, 100, 200, 300, or all companies in the selected group. Paging preserves your pan and zoom. Company markers grow as you zoom in, and logo size is adjustable. Click a company to center it. Escape or a background click clears only the selected description group. Batch, status, and geographic filters support multiple selections. Filters preserve the semantic anchors; small local spacing adjustments keep markers apart. Companies without text are listed separately. All text processing runs locally when building the snapshot.
Your saved companies, folders, dates, and notes stay in this browser. Export a folder or filtered selection as CSV. No account required.
